stories.title: Saudi foreign minister co-chairs high-level meeting on Palestinian peace process in New York

en.title: Saudi foreign minister co-chairs high-level meeting on Palestinian peace process in New York
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan co-chaired a meeting with France, the United Kingdom, and Canada in New York focused on Palestinian peace efforts and a comprehensive Gaza peace plan. He urged countries that have not yet done so to recognize the State of Palestine.

stories.title: Tiffany & Co. honors Saudi women shaping the Kingdom’s future with Vogue Arabia

en.title: Tiffany & Co. honors Saudi women shaping the Kingdom's future with Vogue Arabia
en.summary: Tiffany & Co. released a campaign film in collaboration with Vogue Arabia celebrating three prominent Saudi women: Princess Deemah bint Mansour bin Saud Al-Saud, journalist Weam Al-Dakheel, and rally driver Mashael Al-Obaiden, marking Saudi National Day.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia dominates Middle East hotel expansion with 50% of development pipeline

en.title: Saudi Arabia dominates Middle East hotel expansion with 50% of development pipeline
en.summary: Saudi Arabia leads Middle Eastern hotel growth with 110,000 rooms under development, representing half the region's pipeline. The Kingdom is investing $90 billion to reach 150 million annual visitors by 2030 and expand hotel capacity to over 550,000 rooms.

stories.title: Meeting of Trump with regional FMs reviews efforts to contain tensions and prevent spillover of the conflict

en.title: Meeting of Trump with regional FMs reviews efforts to contain tensions and prevent spillover of the conflict
en.summary: President Donald Trump convened a multilateral meeting in New York with foreign ministers from GCC nations, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria, and Türkiye to discuss regional tension containment and strengthen diplomatic efforts on ongoing crises.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s economy to expand 4.1% in 2027: OECD

en.title: Saudi Arabia's economy to expand 4.1% in 2027: OECD
en.summary: The OECD projects Saudi Arabia's GDP will grow 4.1 percent in 2027, exceeding global growth forecasts and outperforming all G7 economies. This represents a significant acceleration from the previously projected 2024 contraction.

stories.title: UAE, Saudi Arabia lead digital economy in Arab region

en.title: UAE, Saudi Arabia lead digital economy in Arab region
en.summary: The UAE and Saudi Arabia rank highest in the 2026 Arab Digital Economy Index, with scores of 76.66 and 73.64 points respectively, leading regional digital transformation development.

stories.title: Saudi FM Joins Regional Meeting with US President on Sidelines of UN General Assembly

en.title: Saudi FM Joins Regional Meeting with US President on Sidelines of UN General Assembly
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister participated in a regional meeting with the US president during the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Saudi FM Co-Chairs High-Level Meeting on Palestinian Peace Process in New York

en.title: Saudi FM Co-Chairs High-Level Meeting on Palestinian Peace Process in New York
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister co-chaired a high-level meeting focused on the Palestinian peace process in New York.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Marks its National Day with a Digital Economy Nearing One-Sixth of GDP

en.title: Saudi Arabia Marks its National Day with a Digital Economy Nearing One-Sixth of GDP
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's digital economy has grown to comprise nearly one-sixth of the country's gross domestic product.

stories.title: Saudi Foreign Minister Meets US Special Envoy for Syria and Iraq

en.title: Saudi Foreign Minister Meets US Special Envoy for Syria and Iraq
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister held a meeting with the United States Special Envoy responsible for Syria and Iraq affairs.

stories.title: The four decades behind Saudi Arabia’s national anthem

en.title: The four decades behind Saudi Arabia's national anthem
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's national anthem, which opens with the call to hasten to glory and supremacy, developed over nearly four decades. The composition began as a royal salute with music before lyrics were added in 1984 to match an existing melody.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye condemn attacks on Kingdom, back right to self-defense

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye condemn attacks on Kingdom, back right to self-defense
en.summary: Foreign ministers from four nations condemned all attacks on Saudi Arabia, including recent Houthi strikes, and reaffirmed support for the Kingdom's sovereignty and legal right to defend itself during UN General Assembly consultations.

stories.title: ‎Aramco plans new gas unit, potential listing

en.title: Aramco plans new gas unit, potential listing
en.summary: Saudi Aramco is restructuring its operations to create a dedicated gas division, expanding from two main divisions to three, each with its own leadership. The company is exploring capital-raising options including potential stock market listings of certain business units.

stories.title: ‎King Salman: Saudi state foundations built on faith, justice

en.title: King Salman: Saudi state foundations built on faith, justice
en.summary: King Salman stated that National Day reflects on the Kingdom's foundational principles established under its founder King Abdulaziz, emphasizing faith and justice. He expressed prayers for Saudi Arabia's continued security, stability, and prosperity.

stories.title: ‎King Salman approves King Abdulaziz mosque north of Riyadh

en.title: King Salman approves King Abdulaziz mosque north of Riyadh
en.summary: King Salman approved naming a mosque north of Riyadh after King Abdulaziz, with an 88,000-square-meter plot allocated for construction. The mosque honors the late king's national legacy and his role in unifying the Kingdom and building mosques throughout Saudi Arabia.

en.title: POS weekly transactions reach SAR 12.9B: SAMA
en.summary: Point-of-sale transactions in Saudi Arabia totaled nearly 12.9 billion riyals in the week ending September 19, reflecting consumer card spending across retail and commercial establishments.

en.title: Key Saudi developments since Vision 2030 launch
en.summary: Saudi Arabia commemorates its National Day on September 23, marking the Kingdom's founding in 1932 under King Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud, with subsequent rulers being his sons.
